29. INSTALL ACCUMULATOR SPRINGS AND PISTONS
(a) Coat the new O-rings with ATF and install them to the pistons.
(b) Install the 3 springs and four accumulator pistons to the bore.
HINT: The pistons are marked in relief with either C₀, B₀, C₂ or B₂ to differentiate between them.

B₂ C₂ B₀

(c) Install the 2 springs to the C₀ accumulator piston.
